ProjectionItem.doc: One item in a SELECT projection list.

Star.doc: `*` — all columns of the FROM rows.

TableStar.doc: `t.*` — all columns of a qualified table.

Expr.doc: `expr` or `expr AS alias` — a single computed column. Alias is present if the query wrote `AS <ident>` or an unquoted ident followed the expression (SQLite's implicit-alias rule — for the probe, only explicit `AS` produces an alias; bare-ident-after-expr is deferred).

JoinKind.doc: Form of join between two TableRefs. `Inner` is the default for an unqualified `JOIN` keyword. `Left` is `LEFT [OUTER] JOIN` — preserves all left rows, padding with NULLs when no right row matches. `Cross` is `CROSS JOIN` and the implicit comma form `t1, t2` — Cartesian product, no ON/USING permitted (parse error if either appears alongside CROSS). RIGHT, FULL, and NATURAL are deferred (parse-time error with `"deferred: <form>"`).

Inner.doc: INNER JOIN (also the default `JOIN`). Requires either ON or USING or — by SQLite leniency — neither (degenerates to cross product); for the probe, require ON or USING for INNER JOIN.

Left.doc: LEFT [OUTER] JOIN. Right side may be NULL-filled when no row matches the predicate.

Cross.doc: CROSS JOIN or comma-separated FROM list. Cartesian product; ON/USING not permitted.

TableRef.doc: Source of rows in a FROM clause. Recursive: a `Joined` carries left/right TableRefs which may themselves be `Joined`. Multi-way joins are left-associative — `a JOIN b ON ... JOIN c ON ...` parses as `Joined(Joined(Named(a), Named(b), ...), Named(c), ...)`. `using` is the column-name list from `USING (c1, c2, ...)` — empty list iff USING was not written. Subqueries / derived tables in FROM remain deferred.

Named.doc: A bare table name, optionally aliased via `AS alias`.

Joined.doc: Two TableRefs combined by a JoinKind. `on` is present iff `ON <expr>` was written; `using` is non-empty iff `USING (col, ...)` was written. ON and USING are mutually exclusive (parse error if both). For Cross, both `on` is None and `using` is empty (parse error otherwise).

OrderByItem.doc: One entry in ORDER BY. `desc = true` for DESC; ASC is the default. NULLS FIRST / NULLS LAST are deferred.

SelectStmt.doc: Parsed SELECT statement (single, non-compound). Compound SELECTs (UNION/INTERSECT/EXCEPT), CTEs, and window functions are deferred to follow-up leaves. The probe covers: DISTINCT flag, projection list, FROM (single table OR JOINs), WHERE, GROUP BY, HAVING, ORDER BY, LIMIT/OFFSET. All `option<Expr>` are present iff the clause was written. group_by is empty iff the clause was omitted.

SelectParseOk.doc: Successful SELECT parse: the statement plus the index of the next un-consumed token (typically the terminating `;` or `Eof`).

parse_select.doc: Parse a SELECT statement starting at `start` in `tokens`. The token at `start` must be `KwSelect`. Returns SelectParseOk on success or ParseError (shared with parts/parser/parts/expr) on first failure. Consumes everything up to but not including the terminating `;` or `Eof`; the caller is responsible for checking/consuming the terminator.
